% ADDED figure (2026-10-31), adapted from the user's PHY 513 Problem Set 8 solution; generated by qft-C/tools/hw8/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  ->-/.style={decoration={markings,mark=at position #1 with {\arrow{Stealth}}},postaction={decorate}}, ->-/.default=0.55,
  legdot/.style={circle,fill=figO,inner sep=0pt,minimum size=4pt},
  legout/.style={circle,draw=figO,fill=white,inner sep=0pt,minimum size=4.2pt,line width=0.7pt},
  vtxc/.style={densely dashed,line width=0.5pt,draw=figB},
  intl/.style={line width=0.8pt,draw=figR},
  extl/.style={line width=0.8pt,black},
  legn/.style={font=\tiny, text=figO!80!black, inner sep=1pt},
  fcap/.style={font=\scriptsize, align=center},
}
\newcommand{\lnum}[1]{\tikz[baseline=(c.base)]\node[draw,circle,inner sep=0.5pt,font=\tiny](c){#1};}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
% (a) sunset: lines 1,2,3 permuted by the same pi at both vertices
\begin{scope}
  \node[font=\bfseries] at (-3.6,1.0) {(a)};
  \draw[vtxc] (-1.5,0) circle (0.6); \draw[vtxc] (1.5,0) circle (0.6);
  \node[legdot] (x1) at (-1.85,0) {}; \node[legdot] (y1) at (1.85,0) {};
  \node[legdot] (p1) at (-1.2,0.35) {}; \node[legdot] (p2) at (-1.2,0) {}; \node[legdot] (p3) at (-1.2,-0.35) {};
  \node[legdot] (qa) at (1.2,0.35) {}; \node[legdot] (qb) at (1.2,0) {}; \node[legdot] (qc) at (1.2,-0.35) {};
  \draw[extl] (-3.0,0) node[left] {$x$} -- (x1); \draw[extl] (y1) -- (3.0,0) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw[intl] (p1) .. controls (-0.5,1.2) and (0.5,1.2) .. node[above,black] {\lnum{1}} (qa);
  \draw[intl] (p2) -- node[above,black,pos=0.5] {\lnum{2}} (qb);
  \draw[intl] (p3) .. controls (-0.5,-1.2) and (0.5,-1.2) .. node[below,black] {\lnum{3}} (qc);
  \node[legn,left=2pt] at (p1) {1}; \node[legn,left=2pt] at (p2) {2}; \node[legn,left=2pt] at (p3) {3};
  \node[legn,right=2pt] at (qa) {$a$}; \node[legn,right=2pt] at (qb) {$b$}; \node[legn,right=2pt] at (qc) {$c$};
  \node[fcap] at (0,-1.55) {sunset: $\pi\in S_3$ on $\{1,2,3\}$ and the same $\pi$ on $\{a,b,c\}$; $S = 3! = 6$};
\end{scope}
% (b) fish: exchange of the two lines
\begin{scope}[xshift=7.6cm]
  \node[font=\bfseries] at (-3.6,1.35) {(b)};
  \draw[vtxc] (-1.2,0) circle (0.6); \draw[vtxc] (1.2,0) circle (0.6);
  \node[legdot] (e1) at (-1.45,0.3) {}; \node[legdot] (e2) at (-1.45,-0.3) {};
  \node[legdot] (e3) at (1.45,0.3) {}; \node[legdot] (e4) at (1.45,-0.3) {};
  \node[legdot] (p1) at (-0.85,0.25) {}; \node[legdot] (p2) at (-0.85,-0.25) {};
  \node[legdot] (qa) at (0.85,0.25) {}; \node[legdot] (qb) at (0.85,-0.25) {};
  \draw[extl] (-2.6,1.0) node[left] {$x_1$} -- (e1); \draw[extl] (-2.6,-1.0) node[left] {$x_2$} -- (e2);
  \draw[extl] (e3) -- (2.6,1.0) node[right] {$x_3$}; \draw[extl] (e4) -- (2.6,-1.0) node[right] {$x_4$};
  \draw[intl] (p1) .. controls (-0.4,1.1) and (0.4,1.1) .. (qa);
  \draw[intl] (p2) .. controls (-0.4,-1.1) and (0.4,-1.1) .. (qb);
  \draw[<->,figR,line width=0.5pt] (0,0.55) -- (0,-0.55);
  \node[legn] at (-1.1,0.25) {1}; \node[legn] at (-1.1,-0.25) {2}; \node[legn] at (1.1,0.25) {$a$}; \node[legn] at (1.1,-0.25) {$b$};
  \node[fcap] at (0,-1.55) {fish: $e$, or $1\leftrightarrow2$ together with $a\leftrightarrow b$; $S = 2$};
\end{scope}
% (c) triangle P and (d) the pairing after exchanging the internal legs at C
\foreach \side/\xs/\lab in {0/0/(c),1/7.6/(d)}{
\begin{scope}[yshift=-4.6cm, xshift=\xs cm]
  \node[font=\bfseries] at (-3.2,1.4) {\lab};
  \coordinate (A) at (-1.4,0.9); \coordinate (B) at (1.4,0.9); \coordinate (C) at (0,-1.3);
  \foreach \V in {A,B,C} \draw[vtxc] (\V) circle (0.55);
  \node[legdot] (AB) at ($(A)!0.32cm!(B)$) {}; \node[legdot] (AC) at ($(A)!0.32cm!(C)$) {};
  \node[legdot] (BA) at ($(B)!0.32cm!(A)$) {}; \node[legdot] (BC) at ($(B)!0.32cm!(C)$) {};
  \node[legdot] (CA) at ($(C)!0.32cm!(A)$) {}; \node[legdot] (CB) at ($(C)!0.32cm!(B)$) {};
  \draw[intl] (AB) -- node[above,black] {\lnum{1}} (BA);
  \ifnum\side=0
    \draw[intl] (BC) -- node[right,black] {\lnum{2}} (CB); \draw[intl] (CA) -- node[left,black] {\lnum{3}} (AC);
  \else
    \draw[intl] (BC) -- node[right,black,pos=0.35] {\lnum{2}} (CA); \draw[intl] (AC) -- node[left,black,pos=0.35] {\lnum{3}} (CB);
  \fi
  \foreach \V/\a/\b in {A/135/195, B/45/-15, C/-60/-120}{
    \node[legdot] (t1) at ($(\V)+(\a:0.32)$) {}; \node[legdot] (t2) at ($(\V)+(\b:0.32)$) {};
    \draw[extl] (t1) -- ($(\V)+(\a:1.3)$); \draw[extl] (t2) -- ($(\V)+(\b:1.3)$);}
  \node at ($(A)+(135:1.55)$) {$x_1$}; \node at ($(A)+(195:1.55)$) {$x_2$};
  \node at ($(B)+(45:1.55)$) {$x_3$};  \node at ($(B)+(-15:1.55)$) {$x_4$};
  \node at ($(C)+(-60:1.55)$) {$x_6$}; \node at ($(C)+(-120:1.55)$) {$x_5$};
  \node[font=\scriptsize,text=figB] at (A) {$A$}; \node[font=\scriptsize,text=figB] at (B) {$B$}; \node[font=\scriptsize,text=figB] at (C) {$C$};
  \ifnum\side=0 \node[fcap] at (0,-3.15) {triangle: a pairing $P$}; \else \node[fcap] at (0,-3.15) {after exchanging the two internal legs at $C$:\\ the same diagram, a different pairing; $S = 1$}; \fi
\end{scope}}
\end{tikzpicture}
